_deviation_from_the_brief_ONE_BAND_NOT_T.what: The build brief asked for THREE unclaimed bands. This file proposes ONE for the round, and lists two vetted RESERVES that are explicitly NOT claimed.
_deviation_from_the_brief_ONE_BAND_NOT_T.why: ⭐ DESIGN §6.4 and SIZING §6 both require ONE SHARED DECK SET across the three arms, and DESIGN is the authority over the brief where they disagree. P2 — `D = margin(OPP) − margin(OWN)` — is a PER-DECK cross-arm contrast; three arms on three bands would put OPP and OWN on DISJOINT decks, which (a) destroys the CRN P2 is funded on, (b) makes the only remaining OPP/OWN comparison a CROSS-BAND one, which CL-068 prices at 1.8–2.2x over-dispersion and DESIGN §10.2 forbids reading as a statistic, and (c) spends THREE bands' decision_influenced retirement on ONE verdict.
_deviation_from_the_brief_ONE_BAND_NOT_T.consequence: One band is claimed, one band retires. The two reserves are recorded so the pre-named follow-on cells (the n>=1600 confirm on S1-FIRES, and the G4 Carcasum guard — DESIGN §6.4/§6.5, both of which REQUIRE a fresh band) have swept candidates and the next reader does not rediscover them as 'free'.

_why_one_shared_deck_set: P2 is the leg with the power. At the effect size DESIGN §4's own decomposition arithmetic predicts (+1/−1 on opp/own, D=+2), P1 reads z 1.94 — inconclusive — while P2 reads z 2.75. P2's se is `0.63 * sqrt(2(1-rho)) * sqrt(800/n)`; rho is the residual cross-arm correlation from the shared champion play and it is ONLY non-zero if the two arms play the SAME DECKS. Disjoint bands force rho = 0 by construction AND add CL-068's 1.8–2.2x cross-band over-dispersion on top. The shared deck set is not a convenience; it is what makes P2 a statistic.
